title: Trajectory
description: Serialized form of a Trajectory (a continuous melodic gesture). CANONICAL form omits `name` (derived from `id`), `instrumentation` (inherited from the piece), and `tags` (defaults []). Those may appear only in LEGACY data. On load, (ratios, fundamental) from the raga context are threaded into every nested Pitch. `vibObj` (PROP-6): canonical form emits it ONLY when id == 13 (Vibrato) and always in the v2 shape {rate, extentStart, extentEnd, vertOffset, phase}; the LEGACY v1 shape {periods, vertOffset, initUp, extent} is accepted on load and healed losslessly (rate = periods/durTot, extentStart = extentEnd = extent, phase = initUp ? pi : 0). Loaders accept a vibObj on any id and ignore it when id != 13.

vibObj.description: Vibrato parameters (PROP-6). CANONICAL: present only when id == 13, v2 shape. LEGACY: v1 shape accepted on any load and healed.

name.description: LEGACY ONLY — derived from id in canonical form.

vibObjV2.title: VibObj (v2, canonical)
vibObjV2.description: PROP-6 vibrato parameters. Units are log2 (1 log2 = 1200 cents) except rate (Hz) and phase (radians). The curve is normative in PROPOSALS.md PROP-6: with P = rate*durTot (computed with P = 1 when P < 1) and A(x) = (extentStart + (extentEnd - extentStart)*x)/2, core(x) = logFreqs[0] + clamp(vertOffset, +-A(x)) + A(x)*cos(2*pi*P*x + phase); raised-cosine tapers attach the curve to logFreqs[0] at x = 0 and x = 1 via the first/last cosine extreme at least a quarter period in from each end.

rate.description: Oscillation rate in Hz, independent of durTot. Bounded only in the UI (1-12 Hz).

extentEnd.description: Peak-to-peak excursion (log2) at x = 1; linear in x between.

vertOffset.description: Centre offset (log2) from logFreqs[0]; clamped to +-A(x) when rendering.

phase.description: Phase at x = 0 in radians; the UI writes 0 or pi (v1 initUp).

vibObjV1.title: VibObj (v1, LEGACY ONLY)
vibObjV1.description: LEGACY ONLY — pre-PROP-6 shape, detected by the presence of `periods`. Healed on load: rate = periods/durTot, extentStart = extentEnd = extent, vertOffset unchanged, phase = initUp ? pi : 0. Real stored data carries periods/extent/vertOffset as STRINGS as often as numbers (the old sliders had no .number modifier) and periods is frequently non-integer; loaders coerce with Number() and use the stored value as-is. Never emitted in canonical form.

periods.description: Cycle count over the whole trajectory (v1 quantised the rate to multiples of 1/durTot).

initUp.description: true -> phase pi (starts upward), false -> phase 0.

extent.description: Peak-to-peak excursion (log2), constant over the trajectory.
